senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. דָּאַב) [to drip, melt away,] to mourn, repine.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 23b:8">Nidd. 23ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:17">Deut. XXI, 17</cite> <cite ref="A02141"><he>אֹנוֹ</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="D00236"><he>דְּוַי</he></cite>) <he>מי שלבו דָוֶה עליו</he> a child over whose death his (the father’s) heart is grieved.
<cite ref="Berakhot 16b:21">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>אל יִדְיֶה לבנו</he> may our heart not sink.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81b:7">Kidd. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>יִדְווּ כל הדָּוִוים</he> let all those mourn who feel the affliction; <cite ref="Nazir 23a">Naz. 23ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 47a">Yeb. 47ᵃ</cite> the Israelites … are <he>דווים</he> (some ed. <he>דְּווּיִים</he>, Part. pass.) broken down (under persecution).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60">Gen. R. s. 60</cite>; s. 74; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be afflicted. Pesik. Asser, p. 96ᵃ על אותו האיש שנ׳ over this man (me) in his affliction; Tanḥ. R’eeh ed. Bub. 7 (Tanḥ. ib. 10 שנידוהו, Yalk. Deut. 892; Yalk. Prov. 962 שנדוהו, corr. acc.).
to afflict. Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ bot. מַדְוֶה לה וכ׳ afflicts it (the year, causes prayers and fasting from fear of failure of the crop) in its beginning.
